inspection_basis.reason: The session image channel returns image data without a readable text conclusion, so a pixel reading cannot be reported as assertable evidence. This exercise did not need one: every fidelity question it raises is a question about glyphs, sizes, baselines, fonts or extracted characters, all of which are measured directly from the source and reader PDFs.
inspection_basis.what_was_done_instead: All 150 TeX lines were read. All five built pages were read as PDF text layer. Seven source pages were read as PDF text layer and measured geometrically. Thirty-eight claim passages were checked for verbatim containment after a fixed ligature and control-byte normalisation, and every residual difference was classified as source-side insertion, extraction flattening or delimiter-font control byte. A dedicated character-walk census counted asterisk glyphs after every capital Phi on all seven pages.

instruments.findings: Reader PDF 5 pages / 288055 bytes; TeX 150 lines / 18012 bytes; 14862 extracted characters; 46 anchors all present, 0 missing; 18 embedded fonts; no embedded images; control bytes on page 4 (5) and page 5 (2), replacement characters 0; latexmk log census over seven warning buckets all 0 with no warning line.

0 spans outside the 20 pt safe box; 95 intersecting line pairs (14/9/16/43/13 per page); 2102 empty text spans; 0 replacement-character spans; median line pitch 13.55 pt over 214 samples; text tops 69.1-73.1 pt; common bottom 803.1 pt; geometry margin 70.9 pt.

All 95 intersecting pairs have bounding-box ink overlap, 65 of them involving a math glyph, and 0 show a cross-line glyph collision; no characters lie outside the safe box. Seven source page dumps of 2304/2752/2203/2100/2749/2654/2961 characters.

Character walk after every capital Phi: p. 252 gives 3 Phi, 3 with exactly one raised asterisk at 6.30 pt, 0 with two; p. 638 gives 1 and 1 single at 6.30 pt, 0 double; p. 238 gives 7 single and 6 double at 7.35 pt plus 1 unstarred; p. 240 gives 8 and 6 at 7.35 pt plus 1 unstarred; p. 234 gives 11 single, 0 double, 6 unstarred; p. 217 gives 7 Phi with no star after any; p. 233 has no Phi.

38 claim passages, 38 verbatim by exact letter skeleton (26 prose, 12 display), 0 near-verbatim, 0 divergent; 6 observed text-layer substitutions, all delimiter-font control bytes; every passage has skeleton_contained true with its word-coverage figure recorded.

scope.not_read: The remaining 709 physical pages of the book were not read in this batch, and the Chapter 6 material before and after this exercise was read only as far as the neighbourhood of the seven cited pages. No pixel of any page, source or reader, was inspected.

source_fidelity_boundary: This batch asserts that the private reader contains the selected author material of Exercise 6.88 verbatim and without editorial change, that its own page and folio attributions are correct against the fixed source version, and that the literal features it names are the ones the source prints, as measured. It does not assert that the transcribed mathematics is correct, does not repair the one asserted step of the Comment, and does not certify readability from a human pixel reading.
